caption.text: Most "Context is slow" takes are really "I put a new object in value= every render" takes. This handbook walks the whole path: how useContext actually subscribes, why React.memo can't stop a context update, the three optimisations in order of leverage, and the six measured signals that finally justify an external store. Ten pages, zero hand-waving — save it for your next re-render hunt.
